purpose: Authoritative AISAAutoPilot capability, storage, and safe-execution catalog for Easy Form Builder. It describes the flat valj_efb/form_structer model; it does not replace EFB's renderer or settings UI.
sources: easy-form-builder dev4 at 4.3.1 RC (2026-10-26): palette ids, field defaults (sampleElpush_efb), logic sanitizer lists and the 21-key add-on registry re-checked, unchanged from 4.2.0

vendores-efb main (2026-10-19): logic/ builder rule shape, runtime and PHP validator (show targets start hidden; Free Plus limits), human-shield/ (site-wide spam protection), autofill/ (admin datasets)

form_definition.encoding: json_encode(..., JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), then escape every double quote as \u005c" before persistence
form_definition.shape: Flat array: index 0 is the form object; subsequent objects are steps, fields, options, and matrix rows. Options and matrix rows reference their owner with parent; never nest them.

submissions.normalization_note: Checkbox and multiselect values can be normalized with the @efb! separator; preserve EFB's canonical handling.

global_settings.reason: Global settings can contain credentials, add-on activation, notification destinations, and payment configuration.

builder_recovery.note: The builder saves and reloads the complete array, not individual fields.

date.label: Date
notes: minimum and maximum are the earliest and latest accepted dates, written to the shared milen/mlen keys as YYYY-MM-DD.
The literal value 1 means today, so a booking form uses minimum=1; an empty value means no bound. Any other bare number is accepted by the input but validates to nothing at submit time.
The panel has no placeholder, default value or CSS-class control; label size, colours, position, alignment, width, height and corner all behave like a normal field, mobile variants included.
pdate and ardate are the Pro Persian and Hijri pickers, not styling options on this field.

range.label: Range
notes: EFB itself lists this field as free (palette pro: false) and renders it on every plan; AISAAutoPilot only adds one for Free Plus and Pro installs, which is why plan stays free while ai_create_requires_pro is true. Configuring an existing slider is never gated.
Slider bounds reuse the shared milen/mlen keys: minimum is the left stop, maximum the right stop, and EFB rejects a maximum lower than the minimum.
default_value is the numeric start position of the handle and must sit inside minimum..maximum.
range and date are the only types whose minimum/maximum are not capped at 524288.
range_thumb_color and range_value_color are Pro-only controls; the settings panel disables them without a Pro licence.

file.label: File upload
notes: The accepted-format select offers exactly five choices; customize belongs to the Pro drag-and-drop field, not this one.
Changing the category writes both the file key and value — EFB keeps them identical, so never set value on its own.
Max file size is capped at 300 MB by the control and further limited by the host's upload limit, which the panel shows next to the input.
The panel has CSS Classes but no placeholder, default value or public-results toggle.

dadfile.label: Drag-and-drop upload
notes: Only this field offers the customize category, and custom_file_types is the comma-separated list it then accepts.

The drop zone renders as: a large icon, the caption "Drag and drop a <file type>", the word "or", then a Browse button. icon and icon_color style that large icon; button_color styles the Browse button, whose own bi-upload glyph is hard-coded and cannot be changed.
The icon defaults to bi-cloud-arrow-up-fill and the panel has no picker for it — only its colour is editable.
Everything else in the panel is identical to the plain file field.
Carries pro=true: EFB refuses to render it without a Pro licence.

audio_recorder.label: Audio recorder
notes: Audio quality is low/standard/high and defaults to standard; the 480p/720p/1080p steps belong to the video and screen recorders.
All three recorders need a secure context: on plain HTTP the browser blocks microphone, camera and screen capture and the widget renders disabled.
The saved container follows MediaRecorder.mimeType — webm on Chrome/Firefox/Edge, mp4 on Safari and iOS — so never assume a .webm file.
Noise suppression (recorder_noise) is this recorder's only exclusive toggle; mirror, camera facing and watermark belong to the video/screen recorders.
file and value are both fixed at "media" — the recorders have no file-type select.
The panel carries CSS Classes but no public-results toggle, placeholder or default value.
EFB's palette marks it pro: true, so a Free install cannot render it.

video_recorder.label: Video recorder
notes: Video quality is 480p/720p/1080p and defaults to 720p; it sets the bitrate and resolution constraints.

The only recorder with camera facing and mirror controls. Mirroring affects the live preview only — the saved file is never mirrored — and the watermark is a preview overlay, not something burned into the recording.
file and value are both fixed at "media"; the recorded blob keeps whatever container MediaRecorder produced (Safari records mp4, not webm).
Settings registry: EFB's own docs/recorder-fields.md.

screen_recorder.label: Screen recorder
notes: Shares the video quality steps and the watermark overlay, but has no camera facing or mirror control — there is no camera involved.
Captures through getDisplayMedia, which nearly every mobile browser lacks: the widget renders disabled there with a not-supported notice. Never propose it for a form aimed at phone visitors.
Like the other recorders it needs a secure context — on plain HTTP (localhost aside) the browser blocks capture entirely.
file and value are both fixed at "media".

multiselect.label: Multi-select
notes: The Label box writes both name and placeholder; the panel has no separate placeholder control.
max_selections is the cap the dropdown enforces while picking, so 0 leaves the field impossible to fill: store at least 1, normally the option count.
Default-selected options live on the parent field value as an array of option id_ values; the option objects themselves never carry a selected flag.
Submitted values are joined with the @efb! separator, the same normalization checkbox uses.

switch.label: Switch
notes: A two-state toggle: on and off hold the captions shown beside each state (On/Off by default) and are the only text it carries — there is no placeholder or default value.
el_border_color sits in the stored data but the panel has no border-colour control for this type, and there is no corner or CSS-class box either.
The three switch colours are raw hex on the field, not EFB text-* tokens, and EFB locks their pickers behind Pro.

chlCheckBox.label: Box checklist with quantity
notes: A checkbox list where every option also gets a small quantity box; quantity_placeholder is the caption inside those boxes ("Qty" by default) and EFB assigns it the moment the field is dropped.
Its Field Color control writes el_text_color, which here tints the option labels and the quantity boxes rather than an input.
Corner, border colour and height are absent: EFB only offers those to dropdown-style types, and this renders as a checkbox list.
chlRadio is the same field with single selection.

chlRadio.label: Choice list with quantity (single)
notes: The single-selection twin of chlCheckBox, with the same quantity boxes and the same settings panel.
It has a settings panel but no entry in EFB's current field palette, so it only turns up in forms that already contain one — recognise it, never offer to add it.

conturyList.label: Country list
notes: Options come ready-made from Easy Form Builder's geographic data; the Offline Forms add-on only changes where that data is loaded from.

stateProvince.label: State / province
notes: Options come ready-made from Easy Form Builder's geographic data; the Offline Forms add-on only changes where that data is loaded from.

cityList.label: City list
notes: Options come ready-made from Easy Form Builder's geographic data; the Offline Forms add-on only changes where that data is loaded from.

address.label: Address
notes: EFB's Address tile adds five linked fields; the state list follows the chosen country and the city list the chosen state, so they stay in this order.

maps.label: Map picker
notes: One location picker per form.

esign.label: Electronic signature
notes: Unlike file and dadfile it does keep the public-results toggle, but it has no CSS-class box.
icon, icon_color, button_color and button_text all describe one thing: the Clear button under the signature canvas. button_text is its caption (button_single_text), not the form's submit button.
Requires the EFB Pro electronic-signature component to be available in the active installation.

heading.label: Heading
notes: Display-only text with a five-control panel: the text itself (default_value), its colour, its size, width and CSS classes. It has no label, description, required flag or visibility toggles.
The heading text lives in value, not name — a heading object carries no name key at all, so rename it through default_value.
Its size select offers only the display-1..display-8 steps (EFB labels that control "Height", but it sets the font size); display-1 is the largest.
el_align sits in the stored data yet the panel has no alignment control for this type.

link.label: Link
notes: The address must be one the admin typed, or a page of this site.

html.label: HTML
notes: Content is filtered to safe formatting markup before it reaches the form; scripts, iframes and event attributes never pass.

steps.label: Step
notes: The whole step panel is Label (name) and Description (message), plus Icon, label colour, description colour and icon colour under Advanced — nothing else, and no mobile settings at all.
label_text_size and el_text_size are stored on the step (fs-5 by default) and still drive rendering, but the panel has no control for them; the same is true of visible.
A step is a page break sitting between fields, not an input: every field after it carries that step number. "Multi-step form" always means inserting these between the fields.
When planning a new form, emit it inline in the fields list as {type: steps, label: page title}; on an already open form use the add_step operation instead of add_field.
Step one is id_/dataId/id "1" with empty classes; every later step uses its own number and classes "stepNavEfb".
A multi-step form must also carry steps=<count> and button_state=multi on the form object.
The EFB Free plan permits two steps; further steps require Pro field components.

hidden.label: Hidden value
hidden.reason: Not exposed in the current palette; preserve when reading legacy forms

thank_you_message.role: nested confirmation copy: icon, thankYou, done, trackingCode, pleaseFillInRequiredFields, error

captcha.role: captcha on/off, only meaningful when service is configured

form_settings_contract.private: dead key, never read by EFB; a private (members-only) form is stateForm (form property require_login)

show_icon.role: true hides the steps row (step icons and names); EFB's toggle reads "Don't show icons & names of steps" and its form templates store true. Not a button icon.

show_pro_bar.role: true hides the progress bar; EFB's toggle reads "Don't show progress bar". Not EFB branding.

steps_style.role: steps row style classic, circles, pills or chevrons; a missing or unknown value renders classic (EFB 4.2.0)

progress_style.role: progress bar style classic, bar, segments or ring; a missing or unknown value renders classic (EFB 4.2.0)

currency.role: payment currency; optional on old forms

type.role: form, payment, survey, login, register, subscribe, or smartForm

survey_chart_type.role: none, bar, or pie public-results mode

email_to.role: email field id used as recipient

form_settings_contract.email_sub: notification email subject (Free Plus and Pro)

column_map.role: Google Sheet binding column mapping; requires AdnGoS

template.role: Google Sheet visual template; requires AdnGoS

template_applied.role: Google Sheet template state; requires AdnGoS

id_.role: stable unique field id and logic reference

id_old.role: optional legacy id retained when a prior id changes; preserve when present

elementId.role: optional palette id when it differs from type

parent.role: owner id for option and r_matrix child records

amount.role: global ordering counter; increments for every flat item including options

name.role: visible field label and common submission-map key

value.role: default/current value; semantics vary by type

required.role: EFB flag, stored as 1/0 or string equivalent

mobile_size.role: mobile width percentage; default 100 when absent

label_text_color.role: label color class; may be paired with style_label_color

el_text_color.role: input/text color class; may be paired with style_el_text_color

message_text_color.role: help color class; may be paired with style_message_text_color

el_border_color.role: border color class; may be paired with style_border_color

icon_color.role: icon color class; may be paired with style_icon_color

pro.role: EFB Pro marker; preserve rather than infer

notes: payment options store price
image-radio options can store src/sub_value
offline geographic options can store l/n/s2
The builder's option ID box writes the option's id key, never id_: at least three characters, [A-Za-z0-9_-] only, and unique against every id and id_ already in the form.
An option never records whether it is selected; the parent field's value does (see the selected_options property).

width.note: The twelve percentages EFB's width select offers; the percentage itself is accepted as well as the keyword.

default_value.note: For range this is the numeric handle position inside minimum..maximum. Option-based types are excluded on purpose: their value holds selected_options instead.

minimum.prompt_hint: a character count on text types, but on date it must be YYYY-MM-DD or the literal 1 meaning today
minimum.note: Minimum length for text types, earliest date for date (YYYY-MM-DD, or 1 for today), left slider stop for range. EFB drops the value when it exceeds the stored maximum.

maximum.prompt_hint: a character count on text types, but on date it must be YYYY-MM-DD or the literal 1 meaning today
maximum.note: Maximum length for text types, latest date for date (YYYY-MM-DD, or 1 for today), right slider stop for range. Capped at 524288 for every type except range and date.

file_category.note: EFB stores the category twice and reads the two copies for different things: file renders the visible "Drag and drop a <type>" caption, while value feeds the hidden input's accept list. Writing only one leaves the drop zone advertising one format and accepting another, so the panel always sets both. customize is offered by dadfile only.

custom_file_types.note: Comma-separated extensions, e.g. jpg, png, pdf. Only meaningful once file_category is customize, which only the drag-and-drop field offers.

max_file_size_mb.note: The control accepts 1-300 MB, but the host's own upload limit still applies and is usually lower. On the recorders it is a client-side check on the finished blob; EFB stores it as a string and defaults to 20.

min_selections.note: Lower bound checked before submission; 0 means no lower bound. Keep it at or below max_selections.

max_selections.prompt_hint: the option count is the usual value; 1 is the lowest EFB can use
max_selections.note: Cap the dropdown enforces while picking. 0 would block every selection, so the minimum accepted value is 1; use the option count when the visitor may pick all of them.

selected_options.reason: Default selections are option id_ references held on the parent field (an array for multiselect and checkbox, a single id_ string for select and radio); they must stay consistent with the option objects and with min/max selections.

option_columns.note: How many columns the option list is laid out in. EFB offers it to every checkbox/radio-style list, not just the two basic ones.

quantity_placeholder.prompt_hint: the caption inside each option's quantity box, "Qty" by default

record_quality.note: Each recorder offers only half this list: see the per-type property_values. Audio defaults to standard, video and screen to 720p.

max_duration_seconds.note: Seconds, 5 to 1800; defaults to 90. Drives the auto-stop and the progress bar.

recorder_countdown.note: A 3-2-1 overlay shown after the browser grants permission and before recording starts; 0 is Off. Defaults to 3.

recorder_download.note: Shows a Download button once the recording has stopped, so the visitor can keep a copy. On by default.

recorder_noise.note: Applies the noiseSuppression and echoCancellation media constraints; audio recorder only, on by default.

recorder_facing.prompt_hint: which mobile camera opens by default: user is the front/selfie lens, environment the rear one
recorder_facing.note: Applied as facingMode {ideal}, so it is a preference the device may override, and it only affects mobile. Defaults to user.

recorder_mirror.prompt_hint: mirrors only the live preview, never the saved video
recorder_mirror.note: Adds the efb-recorder-mirrored class to the live preview; the class is removed for playback and the recorded file is never mirrored. On by default.

recorder_watermark.prompt_hint: shows the watermark overlay on the preview; it is not burned into the recording
recorder_watermark.note: The overlay is always present in the markup and simply hidden with d-none when off, so toggling it needs no re-render. On by default.

icon.note: A Bootstrap Icons class such as bi-person-fill. The builder's picker offers the full bi-* set; "bi-XXX" is its none entry.

step_visible.reason: Hiding a step removes a whole page of inputs from the form; that needs an explicit admin decision.

button_color.note: Stored as a btn-* token on the field itself, with style_btn_color holding a custom hex. Distinct from the form-level button_color that styles Submit.

button_text.note: The signature field's own button caption; the form-level submit_button_text is a separate setting.

checked_color.note: Raw hex for the selected tick/dot, offered on every checkbox/radio-style list. EFB disables the picker without a Pro licence, so the licence gate refuses it on Free.

range_thumb_color.note: Raw hex for the slider knob; Pro-gated like the other component colours.

range_value_color.note: Raw hex for the value read-out next to the slider; Pro-gated.

switch_on_text.prompt_hint: the caption shown while the switch is on, "On" by default

switch_off_text.prompt_hint: the caption shown while the switch is off, "Off" by default

switch_on_color.note: Stored as a raw hex value, not an EFB text-* token.

switch_off_color.note: Stored as a raw hex value, not an EFB text-* token.

switch_handle_color.note: The knob that slides between the two states; raw hex.

autofill.reason: Autofill can reference external API connections and authentication

country.reason: Changing country rebuilds option children from the offline dataset

notification_email_field.reason: Must be coordinated with form recipient and SMTP settings

href.reason: AI links need an explicit allowlist/source map

payment_price.reason: Payment settings require explicit financial approval

sms_to_respondent.prompt_hint: send the confirmation SMS to the number typed in this mobile field

currency.reason: Payment configuration is not changed automatically

form_type.prompt_hint: form = ordinary form, survey = survey with results, login = a WordPress sign-in form (adds its username/email and password fields); a payment form is made with add_payment, never with this

survey_chart_type.prompt_hint: only for a survey form: the public results chart

hide_steps_row.prompt_hint: true hides the row of step icons and names on a multi-step form, false shows it
hide_steps_row.note: Stored under EFB's misleadingly named show_icon key: the toggle reads "Don't show icons & names of steps" and true hides the row (admin-efb.js showSIconsEl, class-Emsfb-public.php show_steps). EFB's own form templates store true.

hide_progress_bar.prompt_hint: true hides the progress bar on a multi-step form, false shows it
hide_progress_bar.note: Stored under EFB's show_pro_bar key: the toggle reads "Don't show progress bar" and true hides the bar. It is not EFB branding.

steps_style.prompt_hint: shown only while hide_steps_row is false
steps_style.note: EFB 4.2.0: efb_steps_style_name_efb and steps-progress-builder-efb.js render any other value as classic, and the builder shows this picker only while the steps row is not hidden.

progress_style.prompt_hint: shown only while hide_progress_bar is false
progress_style.note: EFB 4.2.0: efb_progress_style_name_efb renders any other value as classic, and the builder shows this picker only while the progress bar is not hidden.

thank_you_mode.prompt_hint: msg = show the thank-you message again; to redirect use thank_you_redirect instead

thank_you_redirect.prompt_hint: after submit, send the visitor to this address (an address the admin typed, any site; or SITE_HOME_URL for "home page")

email_subject.prompt_hint: the subject line of the notification emails this form sends

button_text_color.note: EFB uses its form input text-color token for the submit button text as well.

email_notification.reason: Recipient address and SMTP health must be confirmed in EFB

notification_email_recipients.reason: Do not let AI choose a notification recipient

notification_email_field.reason: Do not let AI choose a notification recipient field

sms_notification.prompt_hint: turn SMS notifications for this form on or off

sms_admin_numbers.prompt_hint: who gets the SMS about a new submission: international numbers the admin typed, e.g. +491701234567

sms_text_new_message.prompt_hint: SMS text sent to the admin numbers on a new submission

sms_text_received.prompt_hint: SMS text sent to the person who filled in the form; may contain [confirmation_code]

sms_text_reply.prompt_hint: SMS text sent when a reply is posted; may contain [link_response]

conditional_logic.reason: Never a set_form_property target: field-level rules are proposed through the dedicated add_logic_rule operation (includes/Efb/EfbLogicRules.php)

AdnSMF.name: Conditional Logic
AdnSMF.scope: form rule arrays: logic_rules, notification_rules, confirmation_rules, webhook_rules
AdnSMF.ai_write_scope: logic_rules only: show/hide a field or step, set_required/set_optional, jump_to_step
notes: Field rules are gated by this add-on; notification/confirmation/webhook rules currently have a documented gating inconsistency.
Calculation action is excluded from this catalog.

AdnGoS.name: Google Sheets
AdnGoS.reason: Service-account credentials, external spreadsheet selection, and delivery configuration require explicit UI confirmation

AdnATF.name: Auto-Populate / Autofill
AdnATF.scope: fillable field configuration and global API connections
AdnATF.storage: own table emsfb_options_list plus external API connection settings

AdnSPF.name: Stripe
AdnSPF.scope: payment fields and late-bound REST routes

AdnPAP.name: PayPal
AdnPAP.scope: payment fields and late-bound REST routes

AdnPPF.name: Persia Payment / ZarinPal
AdnPPF.scope: payment fields and late-bound REST routes

AdnOF.name: Offline Forms / offline geographic data
AdnOF.notes: Not needed to use the country, state and city fields: without it they load their data online, with it from the site.

conditional_logic.reason: Field rules are gated by AdnSMF and evaluated by the add-on's single validator (EFB hardening H1-H17, 2026-06). Notification, confirmation, webhook and pricing rules keep the documented gating debt, so AI never writes them.

safe_ai_contract.create_form: Only field_types with ai_create=true may be created automatically. The compact efb-form-model.json remains the exact generation whitelist.
safe_ai_contract.customize_open_form: Only field_properties/form_properties with ai_writable=true may be proposed. Every operation is validated server-side, applied to in-memory valj_efb, rendered again by EFB, and persisted only after the current admin explicitly saves.
blocked: notification, confirmation, webhook and pricing conditional rules
logic actions that write values or calculate
URLs and phone numbers the admin did not type
safe_ai_contract.conditional_logic: add_logic_rule only when the open form reports AdnSMF active. Every field, option and step reference is resolved server-side against the open form; choice conditions store the option id_ exactly as EFB's builder does; a rule may not target its own condition field or show and hide one target at once. EFB sanitises logic_rules again on Save.
safe_ai_contract.notifications: Only on a new form and only as approved plan switches: notify_admin writes the site admin_email to the form's email; confirm_to_respondent sets sendEmail and email_to to the form's own email field.
safe_ai_contract.field_targeting: Targets must be an existing field id_ or field label. A type-specific property is rejected when the target field does not support it.
safe_ai_contract.admin_typed_values: A redirect address, a link address and SMS numbers are accepted only when the admin's own message contains them (or, for an address, when it is this site's home page). HTML is filtered with wp_kses_post.
